newsitem.title: UK: Eurostar lands md from British Airways.
newsitem.headline: Eurostar lands md from British Airways.

text.p: London & Continental Railways Ltd, the consortium responsible for high-speed link between London and the Channel Tunnel, said on Monday it had hired British Airways Plc's general manager of brands to head its Eurostar passenger trains unit.

In a statement, L&C, whose owners include public transport firm National Express Group Plc and the privately-owned Virgin Group, said Hamish Taylor would join the group as Eurostar managing director shortly.
Taylor, 36, has had worldwide repsonsibility for a portfolio of passenger brands and the BA "Masterbrand."
L&C chief executive Adam Mills described Taylor's brand-building abilities in transport as "proven and second to none."
"The task now is to accelerate the rapid growth in Eurostar traffic that has already been taking place under LCR's ownership," he added.

LCR took over Eurostar from the British government as part of its multi-billion contract to build and operate a high-speed rail link from London to the northern entrance to Eurotunnel SA /Plc's channel tunnel at Folkestone over the coming years.
The consortium has begun planning for a share flotation to support its construction costs, but has said it will only launch the plan once it has achieved a strong commercial base from Eurostar.
